name: Joey Van Ness
headline: Managing Director, Oracle Consulting Services
about:
Steering Oracle's Services Industries with a strategic focus on delivering transformational solutions to our customers. My role as Managing Director over our Client Partner team encompasses designing solutions and programs to achieve our customer's goals, executive delivery oversight and driving client success in complex SAAS and Cloud implementations. Our team's commitment to consulting excellence has led to the successful delivery of large programs across Utilities, Professional Services, Financial Services, Communications, Media and Entertainment and Oil & Gas customers, showcasing our ability to deliver substantial projects and contribute to transformative outcomes.

In collaboration with a diverse team, my leadership has been instrumental in mentoring and fostering career growth within my organizations, including active participation in initiatives such as Women Lead. My competencies, are rooted in a deep understanding across a variety of industries and technology landscapes, ensuring our clients receive tailored, industry-leading solutions.
… more

experiences.position: CPRD Market Leader, Senior Engagement Leader
experiences.description: Consumer Products, Retail & Distribution (CPRD) Leader for the Oracle Service Line.  Provide executive delivery oversight, oversee recruiting and utilization of consulting team, lead pursuits for CPRD Oracle Cloud clients, and lead the development of industry solutions and marketing messages within the Oracle Service Line.  Current clients include an SCM Oracle Cloud implementation for a large retailer, and Financials & SCM projects and AM support for a global consumer products manufacturer.  Member of the Women Lead organization and mentor of the Outstanding Women in Leadership participants.
Engagement Manager responsible for sales, executive oversight, staffing, delivery, and profitability of Pharmaceutical programs in Northern Europe.

US PeopleSoft Capability Leader, responsible for sales and executive oversight of large transformation delivery programs, recruiting, and maintaining margins.   Sold and provided delivery oversight for an average of over $30 million per year.  Additional responsibilities included selling and providing executive oversight to Oracle EBS and JDE programs, as well as managing several Application Management arrangements.

Director of Business Applications and Director of Information Security responsible for maintenance of enterprise applications, including Siebel and PeopleSoft.  During my tenure, we eliminated costly customizations and brought the applications up to current vendor-maintained releases, which decreased maintenance costs and made Carreker more desirable for acquisition.  Managed the transition process to Fiserv once Carreker was acquired.

As Director of Information Security, the team streamlined risk and access controls meet both Sarbanes Oxley and banking regulatory requirements, thus eliminating existing compliance and audit findings.

Senior Manager in the Deloitte ERS practice, responsible for overseeing Sarbanes Readiness projects, IT Audits, and special review projects, as well as practice management, sales support, account management and staff development.  Developed a service offering to provide QA and audit services for ERP implementations.  Led a team to refine the existing Special IT Projects methodology to streamline the approach across all clients.  Program management and account management of a large, national SAS70 client.  IT Audit manager for 4 internal audit clients and 3 attest audit clients.  Managed a team to develop a custom application for a client to track FFIEC, GLBA, SOX and other state level regulatory IT requirements.

Senior Manager in the PeopleSoft practice responsible for managing several large process transformation and PeopleSoft and Hyperion implementation programs.  Also served as Methodology Director responsible for building a methodology and solution offering that incorporated Hackett Best Practices into standard process transformation and ERP delivery programs for the SAP, PeopleSoft, JDE, Oracle, Hyperion and Lawson practices.  The result was greater alignment between the process transformation and package implementation groups, so that the recommended business processes during the process transformation phase of the program were delivered successfully during the implementation phase of the program.
